independent_pixel_diagnosis: Receiving09 pale CGH17 crown/brow forms a continuous dominant roof; the visible cheek CGH06 surfaces are thin perimeter arcs around a large unstructured cavity. Receiving bill CGH18 root remains too far forward relative to optic/crown.

Failed HEAD03 Design02 replaces the roof with another broad cap, extends unclosed ribbon ends into the bill root and blankets the cheek with a bulky wrapping washer. It does not create the observed fitted curved enclosure.

Source canon and July both show discrete curved crown enclosure lobes, a narrow bronze dorsal accent, an exposed fitted orbit, an internally recessed cheek and a compound hooked upper bill over a separate lower jaw.

registration_diagnosis.conclusion: Two-anchor similarity forces optic and tip to match. It leaves current bill root about49px forward and crown apex about58px forward/30px high. This is a contour-and-proportion mismatch mixed with unresolved source-camera difference, not evidence that all source vertices can be transferred literally.
registration_diagnosis.response: Use held camera inversion to place explicit contour station priors; constrain crown/bill roots independently rather than inherit current crown/root. Compare canon and July outline envelopes. Do not solve camera or move fixed optic/stance to reduce errors.
registration_diagnosis.source_view_disagreement: Registered posterior lower crown differs by tens of pixels between source views; station positions remain appearance estimates until actual source-facing/opposing renders.

projection_inversion.method: Anchored orthographic inverse: image right = dot(camera right,world-core)*1280/ortho; image down = -dot(camera up,world-core)*1280/ortho. Fix explicit x-depth prior per station; solve y,z. Shift cancels in differential about exact held core.

construction_method.primary: One connected closed quad cage for the covered crown/cheek support, with a local aperture fitted around protected optical seats; two separate closed cages for upper hook and lower jaw. Controlled SubD level1 or bevel/weighted normals only.
construction_method.crown: Four or five narrow lenticular curved plate cages each cover one local sector of the common support. Each plate has closed rounded cross sections and a rolled terminating lobe. They share the source dorsal/posterior control-edge targets; they are not long ribbon paths or loose strips. Bronze accent follows upper/lower observed contour spacing and occupies only a narrow ledge.
construction_method.optic: Retain all CGO13 and CGH05 seats/lips. Crown and cheek terminate outside their projected aperture. No annular washer, no new circular tube and no overlay across the protected core. Join shell to back of original seat with partial upper/posterior saddle surfaces.
construction_method.cheek: Fit a small recessed noncircular opening between KI-K1-K2 and the protected lower orbit. Sill follows observed lip; sidewall rolls inward .025–.040world behind near skin into a simple dark pocket, rather than leaving an empty broad void or spanning it with flat strips.
construction_method.bill: Retire all4 original CGH18 visible meshes to change root together with crown. Upper bill ring stations B0/B1/B2/B3/B4/BT form a compound convex root-to-hook, inner return BI/BR keeps the undercut and hooked tip. Preserve the deepest existing tip by read-only extraction on future dispatch and constrain its held projection to BT. Separate closed lower jaw follows K1-K2-K3, ending before the upper tip with an actual visible gape.
construction_method.covered_support: Simple closed smooth support cap is set inside outer shell .022–.080world; crown lenticules cover it. Recess walls and floor are closed to this support. It must not become a broad visible forehead roof. Hidden support needs no interior mechanism.
construction_method.opposing_profile: Author in head-frame local coordinates; use mirrored x cross-section rails joined through central closed crown/bill loops. Apply declared near-side source contour fit by adjusting paired rings, not by making an image-facing flat sheet. Opposite camera must show a continuous cap, two separated bill lobes and a recessed cheek; no backface holes, projecting ends, optic washer or bare support.
construction_method.throat_interface: Head-owned skin reaches existing BODY01 at z~1.36–1.43 with a small underlap; no lower breast/body change and no stance/neck anchor move.
construction_method.hook_tip_custody: On future dispatch, read the actual receiving CGH18 distal final silhouette section and deepest tip vertex/edge without changing it. Reuse the deepest final hook segment curve as successor cage end control; its original payload remains archived hidden. BT inverse world coordinate is only a depth prior, not a claim to have recovered the original tip vertex.
